description: This file is a C source code file implementing firmware header manipulation and CRC calculation for a specific device, based on OpenWrt's imagetag.c and addpattern.c. It defines a structure for firmware tags, includes functions for CRC computation, header fixing, and a main function for processing firmware images.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over data buffer, updating the CRC value.

methods.name: fix_header
methods.description: Modifies the firmware header by replacing signatures, clearing certificate fields, recalculating CRCs, and updating header CRC.
